catalystSpot.preRunup: Space intelligence companies historically run 40-100% in the 4-8 weeks before major government ISR contract announcements. Golden Dome ISR awards expected H2 2026 — BKSY could pre-run into that decision window.

postWin.note: Planet Labs (PL) +85% in 2 months on NOAA and DoD contract expansions in 2024. Satellogic +120% on multi-year DoD ISR contract. BKSY's $30M April contract already showed the pattern — next contract 3-5x larger could generate proportionally larger move.

postLose.note: BlackSky missed a major NGA contract in 2023, falling 40% from its prior high. Losing the Golden Dome ISR bid would trigger a similar selloff — especially if Planet Labs or Umbra wins the prime.

comparableCases.note: Planet Labs +85% in 2 months on combined NOAA weather data contract + DoD ISR expansion. BlackSky Spectra AI is the next-generation equivalent — AI-processed real-time ISR vs raw satellite imagery. BKSY's Golden Dome win would trigger the same institutional re-rating.

MAXAR Technologies +60% in 30 days on NRO long-duration ISR contract. BKSY's equivalent would be an NGA/NRO contract win — the existing $30M April contract shows BKSY already in the procurement pipeline.
BlackSky itself +45% in 2 weeks after the $30M defense contract was announced in April 2026. The Golden Dome ISR award will be 5-10x larger — proportional re-rate could reach 200%+ at $75 moon case.
